title: skill_decision
$comment: CONTRACT SOURCE (canonical). The SHARED emitted-output envelope: the top-level shape of decision.json every wired target-profile skill writes (via _skills_common/write_package.py + the dispatcher). Per-skill decision schemas EMBED this (validators/gen_skill_output_schemas.py) as a self-contained monolith rather than $ref-ing it across files. Lenient at the top level (additionalProperties:true) so a skill may add facet keys; strictness lives in the embedded skill_report + the per-skill pins. The `$ref: skill_report.schema.json` below is rewritten by the generator to `#/$defs/skill_report`. See docs/UNIFIED_OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md.

indication.description: The indication code; null for an indication-independent skill (or a sentinel like PANCANCER if the skill emits one).

headline.description: The skill's headline block: the skill-specific verdict + facet fields (pinned per skill), the shared skill_report object, and the shared consumer-contract projections (headline_block/claim_vector/key_signals) the composer + nomination envelope read.

skill_report.description: The shared unified output object. May be null only when build_skill_report faulted (degrade-not-abort); a healthy run always emits it.

headline_block.description: Canonical hero payload (build_headline). Consumed by tp_evidence_package into nomination.json; typed here so a rename fails CI.

claim_vector.description: The A/B/C/D signal atoms carried into nomination.json + the cross-evidence reasoner; typed here so a rename can't silently null the composition input.

key_signals.description: Reader headline/supports/caveat package carried into the nomination envelope.

cards.description: The resolved card outputs the skill consumed.

fired_rules.description: The interpretation rules that fired against the resolved cards.

provenance.description: Run-level data provenance, including per-manifest resolved release + staleness and the reproducibility lineage digests.

is_stale.description: Wiring staleness audit. Required (mandatory audit field); null/stale_indeterminate is permitted for logical product-id families.
